description: Read the scores and recordings a work on IMSLP holds, edition by edition. An edition is a set of files published under one set of terms: the publisher, the editor and the copyright statement belong to the edition, and its files are the entries under it. A block of recordings carries performers instead, and no copyright statement at all. Address the work by its page title, written 'Work (Composer)', or by its page id, and read it a page at a time with 'limit' and 'offset'. 'editions_on_page' counts the editions the page holds, so it says how far a reading can go. Restrict to one part of the page with 'section', using the names the page itself prints: 'Scores', 'Parts', 'Arrangements and Transcriptions', 'Recordings', 'Full Scores' and others. A restriction matching nothing comes back with the sections the page does hold rather than as a work without scores. The copyright of a score is stated per jurisdiction: 'Public Domain - Non-PD US' is free in Canada and the European Union and protected in the United States, so never report a score as public domain without saying where. No score file is downloaded or linked; the work page is what an answer links to. When you show an edition to a user, credit IMSLP and link that page.

offset.description: Editions to skip, for reading a work whose page holds many.

page.description: The title of the work's page, written 'Work (Composer)', for example 'Nocturnes, Op.9 (Chopin, Frédéric)'. Pass this or 'pageid', not both.

pageid.description: The page id a search returns. Pass this or 'page', not both.

section.description: One section of the page, in the wording the page prints: 'Scores', 'Parts', 'Recordings', 'Arrangements and Transcriptions', 'Full Scores', 'Synthesized/MIDI'. Matched without regard to case. Left out, every section is read.

name: list_work_files

headline.description: What the statement leads with, for example 'Public Domain'.

remark.description: A remark the library wrote beside the statement, for example 'See notes on copyright status for urtext editions'. It qualifies the terms without naming a place.

restrictions.description: The jurisdictions the statement excludes, for example 'Non-PD US'. Empty when it excludes none, which is not a claim about countries IMSLP does not review.

reviewed_in.description: Where IMSLP checks copyright: Canada, the United States and the European Union.

statement.description: The statement as IMSLP publishes it.

blocked.description: True when IMSLP has suspended access to this file, which it does while reviewing the copyright of one. Never report such a file as available.

blocked_reason.description: What the library says about the suspension, as published. Null when none applies.

description.description: What the entry is called, for example 'Complete Score'.

downloads.description: Null when the entry prints no counter, which is not a count of zero.

format.description: The format as the page writes it: 'PDF' on a score, 'MP3 file' on a recording.

format_code.description: The same format without the noun the library appends to a recording: 'PDF', 'MP3', 'MID', 'ZIP', 'FLAC', 'MP4'. Filter on this rather than on the published wording.

page_url.description: The work page. The file itself is never linked.

rating.description: Null when nobody has voted, since the page then prints 0.0 out of 10.

scanned_by_code.description: The RISM sigla of the library that scanned it, for example 'US-R'.

misc_notes.description: A note an editor typed, quoted as published.

section.description: The section of the page it sits in, for example 'Scores'.

editions_in_section.description: Editions left after the restriction, equal to 'editions_on_page' without one.

editions_on_page.description: Editions the page holds, counted here rather than published by IMSLP.

section.description: The restriction this answer was read under.

sections.description: The sections of the page, with the number of entries the site counts in each.

title.description: The work these editions belong to.

title: Read the editions of a work
